people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
translations.bsb: Then the man said, “Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with men, and you have prevailed.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
translations.asv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for thou hast striven with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
